To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we present the first linear-time algorithms for finding large matchings in the classes of 2-connected 3-regular and 3-connected 3- regular planar graphs, and the first linear-time algorithm for finding large matchnings in the class of 3- regular graphs.

(1) there is an O(n log n) time algorithm for computing a matching of size Ω(√n) in a 3-regular graph; (2) there is an algorithm for computing a maximum matching in a 3-connected planargraph that runs in O(n) time; (3) there is anO(√nm)time algorithm for computing a perfect matching in a 2-connected planar graph

we have developed the following algorithms for computing large (but not necessarily maximum) matchings: (a) an O(nm)-time algorithm for general graphs, (b) an O(n)-time algorithm for 3-regular bipartite graphs, (c) an O(nlogn)-time algorithm for graphs with maximum degree at most 3, (d) an O(n) algorithm for 3-connected planargraphs.
